title: The RISC-V 256-function bit-logic table is correct and minimal (reproduced, uncertified)
statement: For every three-input Boolean function, the minimum straight-line-program length over {and,or,xor,not} and over {and,or,xor,andn,orn,xnor,not} equals the value in riscv-crypto doc/supp/bitlogic.adoc: 512 of 512 entries, zero semantic errors. Base max 5, extended max 4. For SHA-2 Ch (0xD8) and Maj (0xE8) the minimum is 3 and 4 in BOTH sets: Zbkb buys zero instructions there.

formal.statement: BFS over frozensets of held truth tables from {0xAA,0xCC,0xF0}; first level at which f appears is its minimum chain length.

scope: SLP length with sharing (Boolean chain), x0 hardwired so constants cost 0; Len column only -- the Dep column is NOT verified.

evidence.note: Two independent uncertified exhaustive searches (the spec author's 2020 one, with no code, and this one) agree. That is still not a proof. The certified version is OP.riscv.bitlogic256-drat.
